Replacement rates were calculated by adding the daily consumption rate to a pro-rated estimate of initial fill requirements. All catalyst volumes were converted to a mass basis using loading densities provided by manufacturer specification sheets. Waste treatment requirements were matched to consumable inputs, implicitly assuming that consumables are not emitted or incorporated into product streams, and that catalyst and sorbent density does not change in end-of-life. At the process-level, process review was evaluated at a DQI of 1, meaning that the inventory data underwent documented reviews by a minimum of two types of third-party reviewers.
